name: SuperTrend long and short
description: Always follow the SuperTrend: long when it turns up, short when it turns down, with 2x leverage.

about.how_it_works: SuperTrend draws a line a few ATRs away from price that flips sides when the trend changes. This strategy goes long on a flip up and short on a flip down, so it can profit from falling markets too. It uses 2x leverage to show how margin and liquidation work.
about.works_best: Markets with sustained moves in either direction.
about.fails_when: Sideways chop causes frequent flips. Leverage doubles both the gains and the losses, and the liquidation price is shown for every trade.
